facial_density_assessment.original_topology: Irregular triangulated combined body/head mesh, not facial animation edge loops. Local subdivision needed for anatomical detail; whole-character remesh would risk UVs and skinning.

head_uv_layout.note: Head shares the original full-character 4K atlas. Component count is within the clipped head subset, not a whole-body UV island count. Skin-colored forehead triangles also occur in original gold slot.
